messages.author: 66467cacceef3ef8
messages.subject: R-INLA download failed
parts:
Hi everyone

I have been trying to down R-INLA several times but I get the following error message:

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)

Warning in install.packages :

  dependencies ‘Rgraphviz’, ‘graph’ are not available

 

trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.2/INLA_23.04.24.zip'

Content type 'application/zip' length 67556788 bytes (64.4 MB)

downloaded 15.4 MB

 

Warning in install.packages :

  downloaded length 16103869 != reported length 67556788

Warning in install.packages :

  URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.2/INLA_23.04.24.zip': Timeout of 300 seconds was reached

 

Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :

  download from 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.2/INLA_23.04.24.zip' failed

Warning in install.packages :

  download of package ‘INLA’ failed

I even tried to increase the timeout using the code:

options(timeout=300)

Please advise what I can do to successfully download R-INLA.

Thanks,

Thembi
